wholePhysicalScope: Georegistered 1912 Sanborn plan corroborated by the Oakland municipal site history and original hotel illustrations.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the Tudor roof silhouette and the open twin-track train shed.
limitations: The present city grade and historic street registration establish the exterior site. Exact elevations, roof ornament, upper rooms and structural detail of the train shed are approximate. The standalone garages, gardens and rolling stock are outside the modelled complex.
